description: AI football prediction: combines the algorithm with live data, analyses the match in depth, and predicts the score. Returns win/draw/loss probabilities, confidence, Over/Under 2.5 and Both-Teams-To-Score. Keep those numbers in the answer. Team names must be English (Arsenal, not 阿森纳). Uses 1 credit per successful call. Identify the match with fixture=<id> OR home+away (date optional, UTC).

away.description: Away team name in English, e.g. Chelsea. Chinese names do not resolve.

date.description: Optional kick-off date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), disambiguates rematches

home.description: Home team name in English, e.g. Arsenal. Chinese names do not resolve.

name: get_match_prediction
